author: lexadoodledoll
caption: FLIP THE TAPE 📼 AND PRESS PLAY ▶️ | welcome back to #conformitygate!!! happy to catch people up on some side a/side b theories 🥰  thanks to @Katie | Stranger Things 🌀✨ for the final clip 🌈  the core of the theory is that there’s another “side” to season 5 (a full season, not just one episode!) so they want us to “flip the tape” to see side b (i believe this idea originated from nightphanges on twt) song: should i stay or should i go - the clash #byler #strangerthings #amv #mikewheeler willbyers lovewinsgate here’s my text theory breakdown as always 🫶🏻 - the night before vol 1 aired the teaser they posted was lucas flipping the tape for max—he never does this in the actual show! - strangerthings.things (an official acc, check out katie’s page if you don’t believe me) posted “flip the tape and press play” on instagram on october 16th.  - the official stranger things tiktok replied to a comment with “time to flip the tape and press play” on september 19th. - “see you on the other side” is a line in the first shadow - “and the shame was on the other side” is a lyric from heroes, which played over the final credits in s5 - finn made a playlist for apple music and said “see you on the other side” in the description for it - sweatshirt noah wore bts of s5 that said “see you on the other side” rightside up and upside down - max saying it to holly before they escape camozots—i do believe holly is a standin for bylers/lwg believers and max’s speech to her here is a message from the writers to us about our strength :’) - the “for will” tape existing with no canonical appearance or payoff. i realize jonathan gave him a tape in s1, it makes no sense to spontaneously merchandise that though - in their commencement speech, the duffer brothers mention the sopranos finale. lowqualitynerd on twt pointed out that the final season of the sopranos was split into 2 parts across 2 years, 6A and 6B - the game derek plays is “ghosts n goblins”, which, when you first beat the final boss, would send you back to the beginning to play again (on a harder difficulty) before you could get the true, happy ending - katie’s argument in her video is just top notch and her delivery tickled my brain too much not to include!! ITS NOT OVER. THERES MORE ON THE OTHER SIDE ✨
